Thiruvananthapuram.major_demographic_note: High urban concentration. Significant coastal voter base. High literacy.

Kasaragod.major_demographic_note: Linguistic minority presence (Kannada, Tulu). Agrarian and semi-urban mix.

Thrissur.major_demographic_note: Highly urbanized. Strong presence of religious minorities balancing the demographic.

Chennai.major_demographic_note: Exclusively urban metropolitan. High working-class and service sector population.
